option_relations.rationale: Spontaneous Intracranial Hypotension (SIH) is a condition that can cause headaches and is often associated with CSF leaks, but it is not directly related to Chiari Malformation as a diagnosis.
Post-Dural Puncture Headache is a specific type of headache caused by a dural puncture, which is not directly related to Chiari Malformation.
A spinal cerebrospinal fluid leak can cause intracranial hypotension and symptoms similar to those seen in Chiari malformation, but it is not the same as Chiari malformation itself.
CSF Leak Syndrome is a broader term that encompasses conditions like SIH and spinal CSF leaks, but it is not directly related to Chiari Malformation.
